│                                                                    │
│  • Usage notes on MCP (Model Context Protocol):                    │
│     • MCP supports both HTTP (streamable HTTP and SSE) and StdIO   │
│       MCP servers.                                                 │
│     • MCP clients can be stateful or stateless:                    │
│        • Stateful clients maintain a persistent session and        │
│          require explicit connect() and close() calls.             │
│        • Stateless clients create and destroy a session for each   │
│          tool function call, being more lightweight.               │
│     • StdIO protocol only supports stateful client.                │
│     • When multiple stateful clients are connected, they should be │
│       closed in Last In First Out (LIFO) order.                    │
│     • MCP clients provide methods like list_tools and              │
│       get_callable_function to interact with MCP servers.          │
│     • MCP tools can be managed at server-level via Toolkit,        │
│       allowing registration and removal of tools.                  │
│     • Function-level tool management allows direct callable access │
│       to MCP tools, enabling wrapping or custom handling of        │
│       results.                                                     │
│     • Tool results can optionally be wrapped in AgentScope's       │
│       ToolResponse objects.                                        │
│  • Environment variables:                                          │
│     • GAODE_API_KEY is required to construct the MCP server URL    │
│       for HTTP clients.                                            │
│  • Packages/Libraries:                                             │
│     • agentscope.mcp module is used, specifically                  │
│       HttpStatefulClient, HttpStatelessClient.                     │
│     • agentscope.tool Toolkit for tool management.                 │
│  • No explicit version requirements or installation instructions   │
│    for 'mcp' module or AgentScope were mentioned. [/Key            │
